onEnter.message:
Namaste! 🙏 Welcome to Saini Samose Wala Kaithal - since 1994, Famous Pehowa Chowk wala!

How can we help you today?

[1] Menu & Today's Specials
[2] Book Bulk / Party Catering Order
[3] Shop Timings & Location

🍽️ *SAINI SAMOSE WALA - MENU*

🥟 *Samosa & Pakora*
• Special Saini Samosa - ₹15/pc
• Paneer Bread Pakora - ₹25/pc

🍮 *Sweets & Dhokla*
• Special Dhokla - ₹180/kg
• Gulab Jamun - ₹220/kg

🥤 *Beverages*
• Spl. Malai Lassi - ₹50/glass

✅ *Today's Special:* Fresh Special Saini Samosa (subah 8 baje se hot pack ready!)

👉 *Order online:* {MENU_URL}

Type [2] for bulk party rates, [3] for timings & location.

🎉 *BULK / PARTY CATERING ORDER*

Great choice! Shadi, birthday ya college function - hum party ka poora ilaaj karte hain! 😄

*Step 1 - Event:*
Konsa event plan kar rahe ho?
(A) Wedding / Shadi
(B) Birthday
(C) Function / Other

📅 *Step 2 - Date & Headcount:*
Event ki date aur approximate plates/people batao.

Example: "18 August, ~300 plates"

🍛 *Step 3 - Items:*
Kaunsa items chahiye?

A) Samosa (Special Saini / Paneer)
B) Sweets (Gulab Jamun / Dhokla)
C) Snacks & Lassi combo
D) Sab kuch mixed platter

Ek saath sab bata sakte ho, e.g. "200 samosa + 20 kg gulab jamun"

Shukriya! 🙏 Aapki bulk enquiry register ho gayi.

Hamari team *5 min* me WhatsApp pe reply karegi bulk rates ke saath. Wait karo!

Kuch aur chahiye? [1] Menu • [2] Bulk Order • [3] Timings
